en.t: At this point Yugiri sent another letter.

units.source_text: 不悉内情的侍女接了进来，报道：“大将有信，是给小少将君的。”

en.t: A lady-in-waiting who knew nothing of the situation received it and brought it in, announcing, "There is a letter from the Captain, addressed to Lady Koshosho."
The princess grew even more anxious and afraid.

units.source_text: 老夫人就不得不问：“是什么信？”

en.t: The old lady could not help asking, "What letter is that?"

units.source_text: 原来老夫人心中已经确信女儿失身，正在等待夕雾今夜再来。

en.t: In truth, the old lady was already convinced that her daughter had given herself to him, and she was waiting for Yugiri to come again that night.

units.source_text: 听见有信，料想他不来了，心中很是不快。

en.t: When she heard that a letter had come, she supposed that he would not be coming, and felt deeply displeased.

units.source_text: 她说：“这信还是应该答复的。

en.t: She said, "You really ought to answer this letter.

units.source_text: 世间少有肯替人辩白的人。

en.t: There are few people in the world willing to defend someone else.

units.source_text: 你虽然自信清白，能相信你的人恐怕很少吧。

en.t: Even if you yourself are sure of your innocence, there will probably be very few people who believe you.

units.source_text: 还不如无所顾忌地和他通信，照向来一样才好。

en.t: It would be better to correspond with him without hesitation and behave just as you always have.

units.source_text: 置之不复，不成样子，也太自大了。”

en.t: To ignore it and give no reply would be improper, and far too proud."
Then she asked to see the letter.

units.source_text: 小少将君很为难，然而只得呈上。

en.t: Lady Koshosho was very troubled, but had no choice but to present it to her.

units.source_text: 但见信中说道：“昨夜拜见，始知公主待我实甚冷淡，反教我专心一意、恋念不舍了。

en.t: The letter read, "After seeing her last night, I realized how very coldly the princess treats me, and that has only made me devote myself to her all the more, unable to let go of my longing.
